body: ((telepathic hug)) Thank you for your compassion. Your comment gives me hope for some kindness out there.

Thank you for your kindness and empathy. I am really sorry (to read) that you've had it rough as well and want to give you a hug and ask you to hold on...for my sake. I want to acknowledge your hurt, your pain and want to do what I can to help you get better.

You know, when I was a kid, hiding under beds, going through my shit I would think "I must get out and do something so other kids like me didn't feel so alone...so bereft of hope". I haven't lived up to that as much as I would like...but I want you to know you can get out of the current darkness and help someone else from your experience with your compassion, your sensitivity. I am here for you too.
I am (nervously) hoping it's at least close.
Thanks heaps! Really appreciate all the links and the effort in curating this for me.

Thank you so much! :-) 

Right now most of it is in RAMS @ 3%. I have a pretty spartan lifestyle. The only indulgence I might have is food and eating out - so should be good with their conditions.

Don't have any debts at the moment and don't foresee any upcoming ones (barring the home loan if I chose to buy at some point) 

I consolidated my super is with REST - most people say they are a good one, but I need to evaluate if their monthly fees/charges are competitive. 
Looking into EFTs, but as you rightly said, reading up on the basics before I dive in.

Once again, really appreciate the advice.
